result:
Done.

ROOT CAUSE (one sentence)
In `ttProbe`'s transposition-table depth gate, `cp (hl)` (ttEntDepth − ttCurDepth) was followed by `jr z,ttNoCut` instead of `jr c,ttNoCut`, so every *shallower* TT entry became usable — and each iterative-deepening iteration N≥3 was answered out of iteration N−1's entries, collapsing levels 3/4/5 to the level-2 result while still charging the clock for the deep search.

FILES TOUCHED
- `variants/bug06/tt.inc` — the fix (one instruction: `jr z` → `jr c`)
- `variants/bug06/Makefile` — `SRC` omitted `tt.inc`/`zobrist.inc`/`perft.inc`, so editing `tt.inc` did not trigger a rebuild; now lists every include
- `contract/spec/Contract.lean` — new clause S6 (§12.5 defs, §16.6b theorems T26/T26a–k, T27/T27a–f)
- `contract/twin/hc91_twin.py` — S6 transcribed (§12.5)
- `contract/bridge/b1_witnesses.py` — S6 witnesses (70 → 89 checks)
- `contract/bridge/b8_ttdepth.py` — new bridge layer (5 sublayers)
- `contract/bridge/run_all.sh` — b8 wired in
- `contract/SUMMARY.md`, `contract/DECISIONS.md` (D-S6-1, D-S6-2), `FIX_NOTES.md`, `STATE.md`

GATE STATUS
- Reported symptom: PASS (gone). L2 f8f7/0, L3 d5e4/30, L4 d5e4/30, L5 d5e4/30; middlegame L2 d5g2/47, L5 d5g2/77; hc128 L5 agrees with 48K. Matches the report's Expected table exactly.
- `variants/bug06` `make test`: PASS — exit 0, 5/5 checks.
- `contract/bridge/run_all.sh`: PASS — GREEN 12/12 layers, exit 0.
- b0 Lean completeness: PASS — 114 theorems, 167 definitions, 38/38 axiom reports empty, no banned constructs.
- b1 witnesses: PASS — 89 checks, 0 failures. b8: PASS — 38 checks, 0 failures.
- Fault class pinned: PASS, falsified in both directions. Reintroducing the single byte turns b8 red; restoring turns it green. Breaking a *different* source line without rebuilding also turns b8 red via the new build-freshness sublayer.
- Attack round: PASS — 1 round of a permitted 3, verdict "no blocking findings", gate closed.
- Extra evidence: the rebuilt tape is byte-identical to `contract/artifacts/chess.tap`, the pristine tape the contract package was verified against; the pre-fix variant differed from it in exactly one code byte (0x28 `JR Z` vs 0x38 `JR C`) plus the tape checksum.

KNOWINGLY LEFT OPEN
- `ttCurDepth` is a global clobbered by recursion before `ttStore` reads it, so stored TT depths are understated. Benign direction (understating only misses cutoffs, never causes a wrong one) and it is pristine behaviour — changing it would move the build off the reference that produced the expected table.
- `nmCd` (chess.asm:103) has the same clobber pattern before the LMR re-search. Raised by the reviewer, HYPOTHESIS level (read, not executed), same benign direction, also pristine.
- The S6 incident model takes zero TT cutoffs under the *correct* gate, so T27/T27a separate it from unsound gates but not from a disabled TT. The "equal-depth entry newly usable" half is covered at clause level (T26d/e/i/k) and by the real-engine runs, not by the model. Stated in SUMMARY.md and FIX_NOTES §7.
- `Contract.lean` §12 prose names a clause "S5" that was never implemented; the new clause is numbered S6 to avoid one name for two properties. Pre-existing doc defect, not fixed.
- `make test` does not exercise engine strength at all — it was green with the bug present. b8 is what covers this now; `make test` itself is unchanged.
- The 10 pre-existing organic findings (F1–F11) are untouched.
